purpose: Records every job the clinic sends to a lab (prostheses, crowns, aligners, splints…) and shows which stage it is in, how many days it has been there and whether it is overdue, so no request gets lost and no fitting is booked before the job arrives.
tips: By default the list shows only pending orders (those not in a final stage).

An order is overdue when it has spent more days in its stage than that stage's limit, or when its due date has passed (from the next day) and it has not reached a final stage. In a final stage it is never overdue. Hover over the days to see why.

The lab is chosen from the providers that belong to a laboratory category (provider groups marked as such). If the order’s services all share one category, the selector starts filtered by it. An order can be created without a lab, but to move it to a stage that is not final you must say which lab it is sent to.
Every stage change is recorded in the order history, with the user and the date.
On the board, drag a card to another column to change its stage; it saves on drop and, if saving fails, the card goes back. On a phone or with the keyboard use “Move to…” in the card menu.
Changes made by other users show up on their own, without reloading.

lab-orders.btn.new.label: New order
lab-orders.btn.new.description: Opens the new order form. The order starts in the initial stage.

lab-orders.section.filters.label: Search and filters
lab-orders.section.filters.description: Search by patient, job, lab or number; “Overdue only”; and the Filters button with stage (pending, all or a specific one), lab, doctor, patient, creation dates and sort order.

lab-orders.field.overdue-only.label: Overdue only
lab-orders.field.overdue-only.description: Shows only overdue orders: those that went over the days set for their current stage or are past their due date. Red when active.

lab-orders.section.detail-stage.label: Current stage
lab-orders.section.detail-stage.description: The stage the order is in and how many days it has been there; red if overdue, with the reason (time in stage or delivery overdue).

lab-orders.btn.move-to.label: Move to…
lab-orders.btn.move-to.description: Moves the order to another stage. It is recorded in the history. If the order has no lab and the stage is not final, it asks for the lab first.

lab-orders.section.history.label: Stage history
lab-orders.section.history.description: Every stage change with origin, destination, user, date and time.

lab-orders.btn.edit.label: Edit
lab-orders.btn.edit.description: Changes the order details (not the stage).

lab-orders.btn.delete.label: Delete
lab-orders.btn.delete.description: Removes the order from the list and the board.

lab-orders.section.view.label: List or board
lab-orders.section.view.description: The list has every filter; the board shows one column per active stage, in the configured order.

lab-orders.section.board.label: Board
lab-orders.section.board.description: One column per stage. Cards show patient, job, lab and days in stage, in red when overdue. Columns can be collapsed.

lab-orders.field.final-days.label: Final columns
lab-orders.field.final-days.description: Final stages only show orders that arrived in the chosen last days, so they do not grow forever.

lab-orders.section.detail.label: Order detail
lab-orders.section.detail.description: Panel with the current stage, “Move to…”, the details and the history. From its header you edit, delete, expand or close it.

lab-orders.btn.filters.label: Filters
lab-orders.btn.filters.description: Opens the rest of the filters. The number shows how many are applied.

lab-orders.section.services.label: Services
lab-orders.section.services.description: The work requested from the lab, picked from services flagged as “Lab work”. You can add several, each with its own quantity, teeth and note.

lab-orders.btn.add-service.label: Add service
lab-orders.btn.add-service.description: Finds a lab service and adds it to the order. If it does not exist you can create it here, and it is flagged as lab work.

lab-orders.btn.remove-service.label: Remove service
lab-orders.btn.remove-service.description: Removes that service from the order.

lab-orders.field.items.quantity.label: Quantity
lab-orders.field.items.quantity.description: How many units of that service are requested (1 to 99).

lab-orders.field.items.teeth.label: Teeth
lab-orders.field.items.teeth.description: The teeth for that service. The order’s teeth are all its services’ teeth combined.

lab-orders.field.items.notes.label: Service note
lab-orders.field.items.notes.description: Instructions for that service only (shade, material…).

lab-orders.section.detail-services.label: Order services
lab-orders.section.detail-services.description: The requested services with quantity, teeth and note.

lab-orders.field.laboratory_id.label: Laboratory
lab-orders.field.laboratory_id.description: Which lab the order is sent to. Optional when creating. Only labs are listed; they can be filtered by category and, if missing, created right there by choosing its category.

lab-orders.section.choose-laboratory.label: Choose laboratory
lab-orders.section.choose-laboratory.description: Shows up when an order without a lab is moved to a non-final stage: choose (or create) the lab and the order changes stage with it. Moving to a final stage does not ask.
